glossary.definition: The circular blob each player controls. Also called blob, player, or ball.
Cell size/weight displayed as a number. Decays approximately 0.8% every 4 seconds. Bigger cells decay proportionally faster.
Small coloured dots scattered around the map. Each pellet is worth +1 mass. Also called pellets.
Spiky green circle that pops big cells into approximately 16 pieces. Feed 7 W-presses into a virus to shoot it at another player (~100-110 mass cost).
Dividing your cell into two halves by pressing Space. Can split up to 16 fragments total. The front half flies toward cursor at high speed.
Pressing W to fire a small pellet (~15-16 mass) toward the cursor. Used to feed teammates, shoot viruses, or reduce mass for speed.
Split cells rejoin after a timer based on mass. Bigger cells take longer to merge. Players are vulnerable while split.
Automatic mass loss of approximately 0.8% every 4 seconds. Makes extreme size difficult to maintain long-term.
Transparent cell appearing at the location where a player died. An Expanding Land-exclusive feature visible on the minimap.
The circular arena in Expanding Land that auto-resizes from 0.25x to 8x scale based on player count. During contraction, the outer ring becomes a Danger Zone.
The outer ring of the arena during map contraction. Being in the Danger Zone adds +0.01 to the anti-teaming multiplier per cycle, discouraging edge camping.
Exponential multiplier decay system (Delta Server-style): decay = base × pow(1.086, multiplier). Penalises excessive mass sharing between cooperating players.
Anti-cheat system where each connected player receives different coordinate offsets from the server, preventing external tools from sharing exact positions.
A rapid double or triple split for extended range. Involves pressing split in quick succession (Q key or spacebar combos) to reach distant targets.
Intentional virus pop combined with split. The player uses a virus pop to scatter their own cells and then splits from the scattered fragments to reach targets.
Also called self-feed. Rapid W ejection between own split cells to transfer mass from one fragment to another, often to grow a cell before splitting it at a target.
A straight-line rapid multi-split (x8 or x16) in a straight line toward the cursor. Configurable timing (delay between splits) and lock duration.

A movement technique: while its key is held the cell heads far toward the cursor direction; with the left mouse button held too, the direction snaps to one of 16. Allows precise cell positioning for split tricks.
A deception technique where a player appears to feed or retreat to lure an opponent into range, then quickly splits to consume them.
Two or more players cooperating in Free-for-All mode. Expanding Land has an anti-teaming system that penalises excessive mass sharing.
Controlling multiple game connections simultaneously. Expanding Land allows up to 4 simultaneous accounts per player. Legend Mod provides multibox UI and controls.
A player watching the game without playing. Expanding Land provides 200+ spectator slots with a free-roam camera. Press Escape to spectate.
Free-for-All game mode. Competitive individual play where every player competes against everyone else.
Team-based game mode on supported arenas with assigned team colours. Players cooperate with their team.
Your own saved themes, under the Theme preset list in the Theme tab: up to 30, each with its last 5 versions.
Offline mode for practising against bots without connecting to a server. Uses MultiOgar protocol. Tracks personal bests and replays ghost of best run.
Full playback tool for recorded game replays. Supports timeline, bookmarks, variable speed (0.25x-4x), pause, seek, and packet-by-packet stepping.
Hook API for user scripts to listen to game events. Provides frozen plain data for listeners; failing listeners are logged but do not stop the game.
A tool for dragging and resizing HUD elements (leaderboard, minimap, stats, chat) into named layouts. Supports up to 20 layouts with grid snapping.
